description: Rung 3 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_PRODUCT_SHELL_DEMO_READINESS_SERIES. Cross-panel coverage of the live shell. Asserts that the happy path (Idea Lab verified Python CLI demo when evidence is available; AWAITING_EVIDENCE otherwise) AND the blocked path (broad-claim refusal, pre-smoke working-claim refusal, missing-verifier refusal) are BOTH visible in the React shell. Asserts: Idea Lab verified-demo-status component renders both happy (verified ONLY for fixture demo path) and awaiting (Awaiting Codex reconciliation banner) modes; the splash demo panel marks 5 steps with happy/blocked/teaching/proof markers and enumerates the four broad-claim caveats; the Idea Lab workflow panel surfaces VERIFIED_WORKING_LOCAL_APP for the happy path and WORKING_DISABLED_NO_VERIFIER_EVIDENCE for the blocked path; the Repo Clinic panel surfaces VERIFIER_MISSING; the Maintenance Bay panel surfaces UPDATED_LABEL_DISABLED_NO_VERIFIER; the Learning Studio teaching-window-blocked-reason testid explains why blocked paths are blocked and carries the cannot-approve / cannot-mark-success / cannot-mutate captions; the Proof / Operator Center surfaces evidence ledger, training-false badge (data-training-eligible='false'), operator-actions data-kind='request' (never grant), and blocked-actions list. Driver tests confirm the loader blocks broad-claim insertions ANYWHERE in evidence (not just inside known fields) and blocks pre-smoke verified-working-local-app claims.
